data.question: Angka Partisipasi Kasar SD di Papua berapa?

value.raw_question: Angka Partisipasi Kasar SD di Papua berapa?

value.sql:
SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, nilai AS periode, nilai AS nilai
FROM nilai_indikator
JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)

SELECT T1.nama AS wilayah, T2.periode, SUM(T3.nilai) AS nilai
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T3 ON T1.kode = T3.kode_provinsi
JOIN indikator AS T2 ON T3.kode_indikator = T2.kode
WHERE T3.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND T3.periode = :periode
  AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY T1.nama, T2.periode
ORDER BY T3.nilai DESC;

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, nilai_indikator.periode AS periode, nilai_indikator.nilai AS nilai
FROM nilai_indikator
INNER JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
ORDER BY nilai_indikator.nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    periode,
    SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM 
    nilai_indikator
JOIN 
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY 
    provinsi.kode, periode
ORDER BY 
    nilai DESC;

SELECT
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    periode,
    SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM
    nilai_indikator
JOIN
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
    provinsi.nama, periode;

SELECT DISTINCT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, nilai_indikator.nilai AS nilai
FROM nilai_indikator
INNER JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
ORDER BY nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    nilai_indikator.periode AS periode,
    AVG(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM 
    nilai_indikator
JOIN 
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY 
    provinsi.nama, nilai_indikator.periode
ORDER BY 
    nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, periode, SUM(nilai) AS nilai
FROM nilai_indikator
JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;
